channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: 22-year-old e-scooter rider seriously injured after crashing into pole in Tel Aviv-Yafo
item.description:
A 22-year-old electric scooter rider was seriously injured after crashing into a pole in Tel Aviv-Yafo.
Magen David Adom teams provided him with medical treatment and evacuated him to Ichilov Hospital in the city.

item.title: Report: Trump seeks new summit with Kim Jong Un as early as this fall
item.description: President Trump is pushing aides to arrange a fall meeting with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, seeking to revive stalled nuclear diplomacy, according to The Wall Street Journal.

item.title: Two men seriously and moderately injured in shooting in Kafr Manda
item.description:
Two men were seriously and moderately injured in a shooting incident in Kafr Manda. Police have launched an investigation and are conducting searches for suspects.
According to police, the incident appears to be criminally motivated, and the circumstances are being investigated.

item.title: US envoy: Israeli strikes in Syria risked escalation with Turkey
item.description: US envoy Tom Barrack says Israeli strikes in Syria highlight the need for Israel, Syria and Turkey to establish a mechanism to prevent escalation.

item.title: Report in Lebanon: Israel strikes several locations in southern Lebanon
item.description: Lebanon's Al Mayadeen TV, which is affiliated with the Hezbollah terrorist organization, reported that the Israel Air Force carried out strikes on the outskirts of the town of Qantara, in the Ali Taher ridge area, and in the outskirts of Kfar Roummane in southern Lebanon.

item.title: US sanctions ICC president and senior lawyer, Netanyahu praises the move
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio announces sanctions against ICC President Tomoko Akane and senior lawyer Abdoulaye Seye. Netanyahu: The ICC has become a kangaroo court.

item.title: Security source: Israel tried to reach understanding with Syrian President through indirect talks
item.description:
Following the Israeli strike in Syria, a security source told Kan 11 News that Israel had recently sought to reach an understanding with Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa through an indirect channel of communication. After the behind-the-scenes efforts failed, Israel provided the United States with intelligence indicating that Turkey was seeking to establish a presence at an airport in Syria, approximately 70 kilometers from the Israeli border. Israel argued that this constituted a violation of the understandings.
According to the source, after the talks failed and before Turkish forces arrived, Israel struck the Syrian base, where rehabilitation work had begun recently.

item.title: UAE halts trade and financial transactions with Iran until further notice
item.description: The UAE suspends all trade, commercial exchanges and financial transactions with Iran, citing regional escalations that threaten peace and security.

item.title: Chief of Staff to Katz family: After 44 years, the Battle of Sultan Yacoub is over
item.description:
IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir spoke with the family of the late Yehuda Yekutiel Katz following the return of his remains to Israel. “Today, the circle has been closed. All those missing from the battle have been returned to Israel," he said.
The family thanked the Chief of Staff for his words and for the efforts to bring Yehuda home, to be buried in Israel. They added that his funeral will unite the entire nation and will be held in accordance with his unique character.

item.title: PM's Office on Syria strikes: Syria permitted Turkish troops to deploy at base near Aleppo
item.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Office on Tuesday evening issued an English-language statement commenting on the airstrikes in Syria the previous night.
"Israel and Syria agreed to a status quo in security matters, which Syria was on the verge of breaching by permitting Turkish troops to deploy at an airbase near Aleppo. Israel repeatedly warned Syria that such a deployment would pose a threat to Israel's security. Syria chose to ignore these warnings. Israel will not tolerate threats to its security, and would welcome a return to the status quo," the statement said.

item.title: The encounter with a wounded soldier that moved Netanyahu
item.description: During a visit to Ariel University, Netanyahu met Amit, who was wounded by sniper fire in Gaza: “A moment that moved me deeply."

item.title: Before you tell me to "Free Palestine", I have some questions for you
item.description: And also some information: The Jewish people are not foreign tourists or colonizers in Judea. We did not name ourselves after this land. This land was named after us.

item.title: After the Likud primaries: Two polls put Netanyahu in first place by a wide margin
item.description: Two polls published after the primaries place the Likud in first place with 31-32 seats, and Eisenkot’s party in second place with 24.

item.title: Har Hevron surprises with a record 80% voter turnout in Likud primaries
item.description: The number of Likud members in Har Hevron surged from around 150 to approximately 600, with 80% of them voting in the primaries. Erez Tadmor received the highest support.

item.title: Erdan: “Likud has completely lost touch with the Religious Zionist community"
item.description: Gilad Erdan, in an interview with Arutz Sheva, criticizes the changes in Likud, appeals to the Religious Zionist community, and presents his positions on the draft issue and the next government.

item.title: Planned attack at the Forum Club: 'I wanted to blow up the people dancing there'
item.description: Abdullah Gargawi, with ties to ISIS, planned an attack at Beersheba’s Forum Club, 'I wanted to blow up the people dancing there - Jews or Arabs.'

item.title: US imposes sanctions on president of International Criminal Court in The Hague
item.description: The US has announced sanctions against the president of the International Criminal Court in The Hague.

item.title: IDF: Nukhba commanders attacked during a meeting in Gaza
item.description:
The IDF announced that in an attack earlier today, the IDF struck a meeting of Nukhba commanders, including a company commander, three platoon commanders, and several additional terrorists.
The terrorists advanced terror attacks against IDF troops operating in the Gaza Strip. One of the terrorists also infiltrated Israeli territory and participated in the October 7th Massacre.
Prior to the strike, measures were taken to mitigate harm to uninvolved civilians. The IDF will provide further updates on the results of the strike.

item.title: Israel Dog Unit joins forces with Prison Service dog handlers
item.description: The Israel Dog Unit and Israel Prison Service are deepening cooperation, sharing expertise in working dogs, missing-person searches, and lifesaving operations during a professional meeting.

item.title: Colombia: Israeli aid delegation has rescued 17 people after earthquake
item.description: Following the Colombian government’s declaration, operations are transitioning to the recovery phase.

item.title: After 44 years: Remains of missing IDF soldier Yehuda Katz brought to Israel
item.description:
IDF, Military Intelligence and Mossad return remains of Staff Sgt. Yehuda Katz, who fell in the 1982 Battle of Sultan Yacoub and was missing for 44 years. His family was notified following his identification, completing the return of all missing soldiers from that battle.

item.title: AG demands action: 80% of draft dodgers found to come from haredi community
item.description: A summary of the latest draft year finds that Haredim account for about 80% of all draft dodgers. The Attorney General is demanding expanded sanctions and the resumption of proactive arrests.

item.title: Netanyahu: Sara and I mourn together with family of Hillel Mordechai Dadon
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated: "My wife Sara and I mourn the deep pain of Tamar and Amos Dadon, whose son Hillel Mordechai, of blessed memory, was brutally murdered last night in Beit Shemesh. We pray for the well-being of the other child who was injured in the incident and wish him a swift and complete recovery. Our hearts are with the Dadon family and with the residents of Beit Shemesh in this difficult and painful hour."

item.title: The IDF struck Hamas commanders in the Shati area who planned to carry out terror attacks
item.description:
A short while ago, the IDF struck several Hamas commanders in the Shati area in the northern Gaza Strip.
The terrorists planned to carry out terror attacks against IDF troops operating in the Gaza Strip. The terrorists were struck in a precise aerial strike to remove the threat.
Prior to the strike, steps were taken to mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precise munitions and aerial surveillance.

item.title: Warning to hikers: Unusual pollution in northern streams - may be dangerous to enter water
item.description: Ministries of Health and Environmental Protection warn against entering several streams in the north after water tests showed irregularities, including Banias, Hatzbani, Jordan, Meshusim, Gilabon, Zaki, Yehudiyah, Tzalmon and Kziv.

item.title: Sweden’s betrayal of Raoul Wallenberg
item.description: He rescued tens of thousands of Jews, redeemed Sweden’s compromised wartime reputation, and became one of history’s greatest humanitarians. Then Stockholm abandoned its own diplomat to Stalin’s prisons-and left his desperate mother to fight largely alone. Op-ed.

item.description: Syrian Foreign Minister announces that the IAEA will receive access to a site in Deir ez-Zor after more than 18 years, effectively confirming the presence of nuclear material in the country.
